ablation.name: d7b_deep_backbone_lr5e5
ablation.notes: D7b: Backbone capacity expansion with stable training. num_res_blocks 4→6, lr 2e-4→5e-5 (4x lower), grad_clip 1.0→0.5 (2x tighter). D7 (lr=2e-4) had nan at epoch 1 75%. Theory: deeper network has larger gradient variance, needs lower lr and tighter clipping. Goal: DINO-sty >= 0.49 with stable training.
